title: 第851章 你的目光太浅第850章 圆满大乘
slug: 全宗开挂大师姐她就爱贴脸开大
lines: 同为圆满大乘，凭什么他父亲能坐在渊魔族族长的位置，而他只能得到少主之名？
他弑父了。
他的父亲跪在他脚边，没有愤怒，没有不甘，没有怨恨，相反，他笑了，抬头看他的眼神像是看一件世间最完美的艺术品。
“不愧是我的儿子。”
这是他父亲活着时说的最后一句话。
他也笑了，像是得到了这个世界最珍贵的宝物。
看，他没有做错什么，他的父亲在夸他，并为他而感到骄傲。
坐在渊魔族族长位置，他又开始不满足，魔族有着严格的等级之分，最强的是天魔，而不是他渊魔。
他杀上天魔族，渊魔之气直指天魔族族长，也是他们魔族的魔主，至强者。
“打赢我，或者换我坐那个位置。”
后面每每回想这一幕，他偶尔也觉得，那时的他真是嚣张的没边了。
魔主垂首看他，那眼神，他熟悉的不能再熟悉，他父亲就是这么看他的，像看一个令他们无比满意的作品。
魔主同意了他的邀战。
那一战给他的冲击不亚于后面他被妖界修真界围攻至死。
不，那六个圆满大乘根本无法同他的魔主相比。
至少，和那六个圆满大乘打，他还反杀了两人，而他在魔主面前，如三岁孩童，毫无反抗之力。
倒在地上，他闭眼等待死亡。
在他认知里，输就等于死。
弱者死在强者手里是荣幸，魔主比他强，被魔主杀死，他该高兴荣幸。
可魔主没有杀他，魔主几乎是温柔的将他从地上拉起，为他疗伤，告诉他，一次失败并不能代表什么，更不能否定他这个人。
“你的目光太浅了，这个世界还有很多值得追寻的东西。”
他不解，他都把主意打在魔族统领头上了，他的目光还浅吗？
他问，“比如？”
魔主看着他许久，吐出两字，“三界。”
“只当魔族的魔主有什么意思，成为三界的主宰才真的了不起。”
他若有所思。
接着三界大战爆发，他首次露面便被修真界妖界列为一等危险人物。
妖界修真界联手杀他，赴战的路上他甚至还在想，若他拎着几颗修真界妖界圆满大乘的头颅，魔主会开心吗？
自大嚣张惯了，他根本没想到自己会输。
肉身碎掉那一刻，他清清楚楚听到了心底的一道声音。
他不能死。
不是不想死，而是不能死。
还没有一统三界，他怎能死？
不知是否是错觉，意识逐渐消沉时，他感觉有一道能量钻进了他的脑海，强迫他清醒。
后面无尽岁月，他不止一次去想，那道能量是什么，从哪里来，可始终没有头绪，他甚至怀疑，是不是根本没有能量唤醒他，不过是他自己的求生欲。
清醒过来，他感知到距离他数万公里外有法则波动。
他很清楚这股波动代表什么，代表有大型秘境即将开启。
他伪装被打碎灵魂，实则是自己将自己灵魂撕裂。
content_en:
Both are Perfect Mahayana, why can his father sit in the position of the leader of the Abyssal Demon Clan, while he can only get the name of Young Master?
He committed patricide.
His father knelt at his feet. There was no anger, no unwillingness, no resentment. On the contrary, he smiled and looked up at him as if he were looking at the most perfect work of art in the world.
"As expected of my son."
These were the last words his father spoke while alive.
He also smiled, as if he had obtained the most precious treasure in the world.
See, he did nothing wrong and his father was praising him and being proud of him.
Sitting in the position of leader of the Abyss Demon Clan, he began to feel dissatisfied again. The Demon Clan had a strict hierarchy, and the strongest one was the Heavenly Demon, not the Abyss Demon himself.
He killed the Heavenly Demon Clan, and the aura of the Abyss Demon was directed at the leader of the Celestial Demon Clan, who was also the Demon Lord and the most powerful of their Demon Clan.
"Beat me, or take my seat instead."
Whenever he thought about this scene later, he occasionally felt that he was so arrogant at that time.
The Demon Lord lowered his head and looked at him. That look was so familiar to him. This was how his father looked at him, as if he were looking at a work that made them extremely satisfied.
The Demon Lord agreed to his invitation to fight.
The impact of that battle on him was no less than that of being besieged to death by the demon world and the cultivator world later.
No, those six perfect Mahayana are in no way comparable to his demon lord.
At least, he fought against the six Perfect Mahayana and killed two of them. However, in front of the demon lord, he was like a three-year-old child with no power to resist.
Falling to the ground, he closed his eyes and waited for death.
In his mind, losing equals death.
It is an honor for a weak person to die in the hands of a strong person. The devil is stronger than him and he should be happy and honored to be killed by the devil.
But the Demon Lord did not kill him. The Demon Lord almost gently pulled him up from the ground, healed his wounds, and told him that a failure did not mean anything, nor could it deny him as a person.
"Your vision is too shallow. There are still many things worth pursuing in this world."
He was puzzled. He had already set his sights on the leader of the demon clan. Was he still short-sighted?
He asked, "Like?"
The Demon Lord looked at him for a long time and uttered two words, "Three Realms."
"What's the point of being the demon lord of the demon clan? Being the master of the three realms is truly amazing."
he mused.
Then the Three Realms War broke out, and when he first appeared, he was listed as a first-class dangerous person by the demon world of cultivation.
The demon world and the cultivator world joined forces to kill him. On the way to the battle, he even thought, would the demon lord be happy if he carried a few heads of the perfect Mahayana in the demon world and the cultivator world?
He was used to being arrogant and arrogant, and he never thought that he would lose.
The moment his body shattered, he clearly heard a voice in his heart.
He cannot die.
It’s not that I don’t want to die, it’s that I can’t die.
How could he die without unifying the three realms?
Not sure if it was an illusion, but as his consciousness gradually sank, he felt a burst of energy penetrate into his mind, forcing him to wake up.
In the endless years that followed, he thought more than once about what that energy was and where it came from, but he still had no clue. He even wondered whether there was no energy at all to awaken him, but it was just his own desire to survive.
When he woke up, he sensed law fluctuations tens of thousands of kilometers away from him.
He knew very well what this fluctuation represented, which meant that a large secret realm was about to open.
He pretended to have his soul shattered, but in fact he tore his own soul apart.
title_en: Chapter 851: Your vision is too shallow Chapter 850: Perfect Mahayana
